1//! Optional content (layers).
2//!
3//! An optional content group (OCG) is a named layer that a viewer can show or hide. Create
4//! groups on the [`Document`] with [`Document::add_optional_content_group`], then mark
5//! content on any surface with [`Surface::start_optional_content`] and
6//! [`Surface::end_optional_content`].
7//!
8//! Every group is written once as `<< /Type /OCG /Name (…) >>`, and the catalog gets
9//! `/OCProperties` listing all groups, also those that no page uses, with the hidden ones
10//! in the default configuration's `/OFF` array. Marked content is written as
11//! `/OC /ocN BDC … EMC`, with `/ocN` registered in the `/Properties` resources of the
12//! stream that holds it.
13//!
14//! Optional content marks nest independently of tagged sections, but they must not overlap
15//! them: a tagged section started inside a mark ends before the mark does, and a mark started
16//! inside a tagged section ends before the section does. Marks are balanced per stream: a mark
17//! started before [`Surface::push_group`] (or any other push that starts a new stream, such as
18//! an opacity or a mask) can't be ended inside it.
19//!
20//! Optional content needs PDF 1.5 and is forbidden in PDF/A-1.
21//!
22//! [`Surface::push_group`]: crate::third_party::krilla::surface::Surface::push_group
23

40/// An optional content group of a [`Document`], returned by
41/// [`Document::add_optional_content_group`].
42///
43/// An id is only meaningful for the document that created it.
44#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
45pub struct OcgId(usize);
46
47struct Group {
48    ref_: Ref,
49    visible: bool,
50}
51
52/// The document's optional content groups and settings.
53#[derive(Default)]
54pub(crate) struct OptionalContent {
55    groups: Vec<Group>,
56    page_mode: bool,
57    /// Where the first unbalanced or overlapping mark was found;
58    /// [`SerializeContext::finish`] fails with [`KrillaError::UnbalancedOptionalContent`].
59    pub(crate) misuse: Option<Option<Location>>,
60}
61
62impl OptionalContent {
63    fn group_ref(&self, id: OcgId) -> Option<Ref> {
64        self.groups.get(id.0).map(|g| g.ref_)
65    }
66
67    fn record_misuse(&mut self, location: Option<Location>) {
68        self.misuse.get_or_insert(location);
69    }
70
71    /// Writes `/OCProperties`, and `/PageMode /UseOC` when requested, if any group exists.
72    pub(crate) fn write_catalog_entries(&self, catalog: &mut Catalog<'_>, remapper: &HashMap<Ref, Ref>) {
73        if self.groups.is_empty() {
74            return;
75        }
76
77        let all: Vec<Ref> = self.groups.iter().filter_map(|g| remapper.get(&g.ref_).copied()).collect();
78        let hidden: Vec<Ref> = self.groups.iter().filter(|g| !g.visible).filter_map(|g| remapper.get(&g.ref_).copied()).collect();
79
80        let mut properties = catalog.insert(Name(b"OCProperties")).dict();
81        properties.insert(Name(b"OCGs")).array().items(all.iter().copied());
82        let mut config = properties.insert(Name(b"D")).dict();
83        config.pair(Name(b"Name"), TextStr("Layers"));
84        config.insert(Name(b"Order")).array().items(all.iter().copied());
85        if !hidden.is_empty() {
86            config.insert(Name(b"OFF")).array().items(hidden);
87        }
88        config.finish();
89        properties.finish();
90
91        if self.page_mode {
92            catalog.page_mode(PageMode::UseOC);
93        }
94    }
95}

97impl Document {
98    /// Add an optional content group (a layer) named `name`, shown when the document opens
99    /// if `visible` is true.
100    ///
101    /// The group is listed in the catalog's `/OCProperties` even if no content uses it.
102    /// Names are text strings, so any Unicode name works; they need not be unique.
103    ///
104    /// Optional content needs PDF 1.5 and is forbidden in PDF/A-1: adding a group registers
105    /// [`ValidationError::OptionalContent`] and, below PDF 1.5,
106    /// [`ValidationError::RequiresNewerPdfVersion`].
107    pub fn add_optional_content_group(&mut self, name: impl Into<String>, visible: bool) -> OcgId {
108        let sc = &mut self.serializer_context;
109        let name = name.into();
110
111        sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::OptionalContent(sc.location));
112        if sc.serialize_settings().pdf_version() < VersionedFeature::OptionalContent.minimum_pdf_version() {
113            sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::RequiresNewerPdfVersion(VersionedFeature::OptionalContent, sc.location));
114        }
115
116        let ref_ = sc.new_ref();
117        let mut ocg = self.chunk_container.non_stream.optional_content.indirect(ref_).dict();
118        ocg.pair(Name(b"Type"), Name(b"OCG"));
119        ocg.pair(Name(b"Name"), TextStr(&name));
120        ocg.finish();
121
122        let groups = &mut sc.optional_content.groups;
123        groups.push(Group { ref_, visible });
124        OcgId(groups.len() - 1)
125    }
126
127    /// Whether the document opens with the viewer's layers panel showing
128    /// (`/PageMode /UseOC`). Only written when the document has optional content groups.
129    /// Off by default.
130    pub fn set_optional_content_page_mode(&mut self, use_oc: bool) {
131        self.serializer_context.optional_content.page_mode = use_oc;
132    }
133}

135impl Surface<'_> {
136    /// Start content that belongs to the optional content group `group`, until the matching
137    /// [`Surface::end_optional_content`].
138    ///
139    /// Marks nest, and a mark may contain tagged sections (see the [module
140    /// documentation](crate::third_party::krilla::optional_content) for the nesting rules). Content left open
141    /// when the surface finishes, or when a group, opacity or mask pushed after the start
142    /// is popped, is closed there, and [`Document::finish`] then fails with
143    /// [`KrillaError::UnbalancedOptionalContent`].
144    ///
145    /// Returns [`KrillaError::UnknownOptionalContentGroup`] and writes nothing if `group`
146    /// does not belong to this document.
147    pub fn start_optional_content(&mut self, group: OcgId) -> KrillaResult<()> {
148        let (builder, sc) = self.content_and_context();
149        let Some(ocg) = sc.optional_content.group_ref(group) else {
150            return Err(KrillaError::UnknownOptionalContentGroup(sc.location));
151        };
152
153        let name = builder.rd_builder.register_resource(Properties(ocg));
154        builder.content.begin_marked_content_with_properties(Name(b"OC")).properties_named(name.to_pdf_name());
155        let tagged = builder.active_marked_content;
156        builder.optional_content.open.push(tagged);
157        Ok(())
158    }
159
160    /// End the innermost optional content started with [`Surface::start_optional_content`]
161    /// in the current stream.
162    ///
163    /// Returns [`KrillaError::UnbalancedOptionalContent`] and writes nothing if no optional
164    /// content is open in the current stream, or if a tagged section started inside it is
165    /// still open.
166    pub fn end_optional_content(&mut self) -> KrillaResult<()> {
167        let (builder, sc) = self.content_and_context();
168        let tagged = builder.active_marked_content;
169        if builder.optional_content.open.last() != Some(&tagged) {
170            return Err(KrillaError::UnbalancedOptionalContent(sc.location));
171        }
172
173        builder.optional_content.open.pop();
174        builder.content.end_marked_content();
175        Ok(())
176    }
177}

179/// The optional content marks open in one content stream. Each entry records whether a
180/// tagged section was open when the mark started.
181#[derive(Default)]
182pub(crate) struct OpenMarks {
183    open: Vec<bool>,
184    overlap: bool,
185}
186
187impl OpenMarks {
188    /// Called when a tagged section ends: a mark started inside it would be closed by its
189    /// `EMC`.
190    pub(crate) fn tag_ended(&mut self) {
191        if self.open.last() == Some(&true) {
192            self.overlap = true;
193        }
194    }
195}
196
197/// Close the marks still open in `builder` before its stream is finished, and record the
198/// misuse for [`SerializeContext::finish`].
199pub(crate) fn close_open_marks(builder: &mut ContentBuilder, sc: &mut SerializeContext) {
200    let open = std::mem::take(&mut builder.optional_content.open);
201    for _ in &open {
202        builder.content.end_marked_content();
203    }
204    if !open.is_empty() || builder.optional_content.overlap {
205        let location = sc.location;
206        sc.optional_content.record_misuse(location);
207    }
208}

210/// An entry of a resource dictionary's `/Properties`: an optional content group.
211#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Hash, Clone)]
212pub(crate) struct Properties(Ref);
213
214impl Resource for Properties {
215    fn new(ref_: Ref) -> Self {
216        Self(ref_)
217    }
218
219    fn get_ref(&self) -> Ref {
220        self.0
221    }
222
223    fn get_dict<'a>(resources: &'a mut writers::Resources) -> Dict<'a> {
224        resources.insert(Name(b"Properties")).dict()
225    }
226
227    fn get_prefix() -> &'static str {
228        "oc"
229    }
230
231    fn get_mapper(b: &mut ResourceDictionaryBuilder) -> &mut ResourceMapper<Properties> {
232        &mut b.properties
233    }
